feeds.title: Our Classroom
feeds.description: Welcome to Our Classroom! In this space we talk about education, which is inclusive of, but not limited to what happens in schools. Education is taking place whenever and wherever we are willing to learn.In Our Classroom, we explore educational journeys, discuss instructional strategies, unpack books, speak with authors, and we think about how all of this is connected to education.Subscribe, rate the show and write a review! For resources to help you understand the intersection of race, bias, education, and society go to multiculturalclassroom.com

feeds.title: Mama Latina Tips
feeds.description: Soy Silvia started Mama Latina Tips in 2009 to connect and share her bilingual stories, recipes, and culture with others in her blog. A bilingual blog for Latinas and Latinas at heart. Her blog is itemized carefully into 3 sections, first where she speaks about her family, second - tips as a Mexican mom, and lastly all her ravishing recipes that are categorized into sub categories for easy access.

feeds.title: Multicultural Kid Blog
feeds.description: Multicultural Kid Blogs is a supportive community that brings together parents, educators, bloggers, writers, and artists from across the world. The mission of Multicultural Kid Blogs is to inspire and support them all by raising the next generation of global citizens through arts, activities, crafts, food, language, and love; creating educational and parenting content that celebrates diversity in all its forms while recognizing common concerns and dreams of children. They work towards a better understanding among people and oppose any kind of discrimination.

feeds.title: Bilingual Monkeys Blog
feeds.description: Bilingual Monkey is a lively worldwide community where parents can share their bilingual experiences and lend mutual support. The aim is to provide practical ideas and inspiration to help meet this challenge of bilingualism with greater success. Bilingual Monkeys is a blog that provides ideas and inspiration on raising bilingual kids, information on bilingualism in children, and resources to promote bilingual development. It offers strategies and support for busy parents seeking to raise children with abilities in more than one language.

feeds.title: Pura Vida Moms
feeds.description: Pura Vida Moms is a personal blog that focuses on traditional Costa Rican food and travel to Costa Rica with kids. Christa Jimenez is a family travel blogger and bilingual mom, who now works as a recipe developer, and food and travel photographer. She provides her expertise & services on travel.

feeds.title: Asheville Multicultural Blog
feeds.description: Asheville Multicultural has neatly aligned its website with arts, restaurants, community, events, food, and much much more. He blogs about everything Asheville has to offer & things to do in Asheville Why. His attention to detail is seen through his neatly organized website.

feeds.title: Diverse BookFinder Blog
feeds.description: Diverse Book Finder team aspires to be a go-to resource for librarians, educators, parents, book creators, and publishers who seek to create collections in which all children can see themselves and each other reflected in the picture books they read. News articles on The Importance of Racially/Culturally Diverse Books and how to evaluate them are also available.

feeds.title: The LOTE Agency
feeds.description: Established in 1998, The LOTE Agency has almost a quarter of a century's experience in delivering multicultural research projects, communication campaigns, and translation services. We are a unique multicultural communications agency that specializes in ensuring you communicate effectively with your audiences from diverse cultural backgrounds by working with you to understand your audience and ensure your message reaches them, through research, community engagement, and multilingual, multichannel communications campaigns.

feeds.title: Culturs Magazine
feeds.description: In the 21st century, assessing someone's background from outward appearance isn't enough - hidden diversity means people increasingly bring more to the table than meets the eye. Whether through travel, nationality, race, or ethnicity, many of us straddle culture in one way or another. CULTURS global multicultural magazine intends to celebrate the unique perspectives of such people.

feeds.title: Maritere Bellas Blog
feeds.description: Maritere is an author & bilingual/bicultural parenting expert who enjoys writing and is passionate about family, languages, and cultures. In her blog, she mentions Family life, parenting advice, bilingual/bicultural tips & tricks, and book reviews. Her website includes her blog, podcast, videos, books, and services. She's quite informative on how to raise bi/multi cultural children and even encourages and includes other moms to blog on their views and inputs.

feeds.title: LadydeeLG
feeds.description: Diana, a Latina New Yorker with Ecuadorian roots, married to a Frenchman. Writes about multicultural families, raising bilingual kids, all things motherhood, culture, and her life in NYC with her husband and kids. She writes about her unbiased opinion on everything she does and how it influences her multi-cultural family and creates podcasts of the same. Her blog is home to all bilingual and multicultural parents.

feeds.title: The Cultured Kid Blog
feeds.description: The Cultured Kid is designed to hit the brain-based sweet spot with learning new languages by combining interest, exposure, and relationship. These are the 3 ingredients that create the kind of magic that will have your kids using brand-new words in just a few days. The Cultured Kid Blog gives tips and advice on how to raise bilingual children and help you teach languages to your kids even if you don't speak one by providing them with an innovative and engaging curriculum of different languages.

feeds.title: Multicultural Motherhood
feeds.description: Multicultural Motherhood talks about raising multicultural, multilingual children at home. As a blogger and speech & language therapist in bilingualism, she inspires many with her work and blogs. She runs an online course to help parents boost their children's speech, language, and literacy skills along with speech and language therapy services. She uses this blog to document her homeschooling life in a multicultural family.

feeds.title: Mommy Maestra
feeds.description: Monica Olivera is the founder and publisher of MommyMaestra.com, a site dedicated to helping Hispanic parents get more involved in their children's education by providing resources, tips, and opportunities. Her blog inspires Hispanic and bi-lingual parents to help their children learn about their multi-cultures.

feeds.title: Discovering Español
feeds.description: Discovering the World Through My Son's Eyes Multicultural and bilingual resources for parents, caregivers, and educators across the globe. A blog for multicultural and bilingual resources for parents, caregivers, and educators across the globe. She's written a lot on bilingual parenting and sub-categorized it accordingly. Her website has all the necessary information that any parent can get access to.
